scope: unloaded stored-state allocation only; no plant rollout

definitions.rms: sample RMS; action RMS per scalar joint, residual RMS Euclidean norm per 2D task
definitions.ff: s*(-Jmoving*dqdesired); original=FF+FB; feedback norms reported separately
definitions.residual: Jcounter*u-original_target or Jcounter*u-FF; original target never changed for scoring

definitions.slew: adjacent frozen-row finite difference, divided by actual command_monotonic interval; not plant acceleration
definitions.postfade: elapsed>T+.5; s=0 leaves exact same posture+damping problem
